observations.claim: An interim AI usage note exists: it bans customer commercial data, personal data and carrier rates from the assistant, and requires competent review before reliance; it covers the assistant only, names no owner, and routes queries to IT by default.
observations.quote: Anything Verrin produces must be checked by someone competent to judge it before it is sent outside the company or relied on for a decision.

observations.claim: The note's coverage boundary is explicit: embedded AI in other tools is not covered.
observations.quote: Other tools' built-in AI features are not covered.
